name: Shard
tagline: Minecraft launcher with deduplicated mod storage and profile management
description: Shard is a modern Minecraft launcher featuring a deduplicated mod storage engine. Its content-addressed library stores mods once and seamlessly shares them across profiles. It features full CLI and desktop GUI interfaces with out-of-the-box support for Fabric, Forge, Quilt, NeoForge, and instant Modrinth & CurseForge integrations.
features: Content-addressed mod storage deduplicating shared files across profiles
Unified mod search and installation from Modrinth and CurseForge
Compatible with Fabric, NeoForge, Forge, and Quilt mod loaders
Native desktop UI with fast command-line terminal control
